problemSigns.sign: Door hangs crooked in the opening
problemSigns.detail: One side of your garage door sits lower than the other. This indicates a cable issue on one side.

problemSigns.sign: Cable hanging loose or wrapped off the drum
problemSigns.detail: You can see a frayed or detached cable, or it has come off the winding drum above the door.

problemSigns.sign: Grinding noise as the door moves
problemSigns.detail: Unusual sounds during operation can signal a cable rubbing or snagging on components.

problemSigns.sign: Door slams down faster than normal
problemSigns.detail: A broken cable means the springs cannot counterbalance the door's weight. The door falls rapidly when closing.

faqs.q: Why do garage door cables break in Downers Grove?
